name: cleverbridge
description_en:
Cleverbridge is a Merchant of Record platform for software, SaaS and other digital products. Its pricing page describes it as a digital reseller that takes a transaction-based share, combining checkout, payments, subscriptions, tax handling and fraud functions.

This role differs from renting a general retail storefront or only connecting a payment gateway. Seller onboarding, product eligibility and the commercial agreement determine which transactions Cleverbridge handles; a broad marketing coverage claim is not approval to sell every product in every market.
description_zh:
Cleverbridge 是面向软件、SaaS 及其他数字产品的 Merchant of Record 平台。定价页将其描述为按交易分成的数字经销商，结合结账、支付、订阅、税务处理和反欺诈功能。

这一角色不同于租用通用零售店面或只连接支付网关。卖家入驻、商品资格和商业协议决定实际处理范围；广泛市场覆盖宣传不等于批准所有产品在所有市场销售。

review_notes: Vendor descriptions are documentation evidence, not independent validation.
Examples and suitability judgments are editorial guidance. Chinese copy does not establish a Chinese product interface.

sections.title_en: Connect a SaaS renewal to access in your own product
sections.title_zh: 把 SaaS 续费连接到自家产品访问权
sections.en: A software company could configure a subscription, send the customer through Cleverbridge checkout and use integration events to update its own entitlement system. The platform supports APIs, webhooks and an Integration Hub, but payment collection and product access remain different states. Evaluate paid, failed-renewal and cancelled cases before relying on an automated entitlement change. No subscription or webhook was run here.
sections.zh: 软件公司可配置订阅，让客户进入 Cleverbridge 结账，再用集成事件更新自己的权益系统。平台支持 API、webhook 和 Integration Hub，但收到付款和获得产品访问权仍是不同状态。依赖自动权益变更前应评估付款、续费失败及取消情形。本文未运行订阅或 webhook。

sections.title_en: Separate subscription configuration from recovery outcomes
sections.title_zh: 区分订阅配置与恢复结果
sections.en: The subscription page lists flat-rate, tiered, seat-based and usage-based structures. It also describes self-service upgrades/downgrades, intelligent payment retries, account updates and dunning. Configure the intended billing and access policy, then verify which event represents final non-payment. A retry capability does not guarantee collection, and a cancellation flow does not prove a customer was retained.
sections.zh: 订阅页列出固定价、分层、按席位及按用量结构，并描述自助升级降级、智能支付重试、账户更新和催付。应配置收费及访问政策，再核对什么事件代表最终未付款。支持重试不保证收款，存在取消挽留流程不证明成功留住客户。

sections.title_en: Use the quoted transaction mix to estimate cost
sections.title_zh: 按报价中的交易组合估算费用
sections.en: The official page gives custom transaction-based pricing, influenced by volume, payment mix, currencies and customer locations; no public numeric take rate was verified. It separates flexible add-ons such as affiliate/B2B partner services, marketing, professional services and billing support. Request treatment of refunds, disputes, payouts, currency conversion and add-ons in the agreement rather than inventing one universal fee.
sections.zh: 官方按交易定制收费，受交易量、支付组合、币种及客户位置影响，未核实公开数字分成率。页面把联盟及 B2B 伙伴服务、营销、专业服务及账单支持列为可选附加项。应在协议中确认退款、争议、结算、换汇及附加项，不能虚构统一费率。

sections.title_en: Evaluate as a digital reseller relationship
sections.title_zh: 按数字经销合作关系评估
sections.en: Digital sellers wanting outsourced transaction operations have a relevant use case. A physical-goods shop seeking warehouse software or a self-hosted cart is a different requirement. Prepare product, business and integration details for onboarding. Vendor tax/compliance descriptions require an applicable agreement and are not a legal determination for the seller. Approval criteria, reserve/payout rules, licence and operational recovery remain unverified.
sections.zh: 希望外包交易运营的数字产品卖家有相关场景；实物商店若寻找仓储软件或自托管购物车，需求不同。入驻应准备产品、企业及集成资料。厂商税务合规说明需有适用协议，不能替卖家作法律判断。准入、准备金／结算规则、许可及运营恢复仍未核实。
